notes: GSC latest available day advanced to 2026-09-19, so the 28-day window moved to 2026-08-23..2026-09-19 (was 2026-08-22..2026-09-18 on the 2026-09-21 snapshot).
GSC 28-day totals hold at 119 clicks - the same headline as the last run, but on a window shifted one day at each end. Impressions eased 4,955 -> 4,888 and average position improved 38.6 -> 38.0.

GSC clicks are -28.3% against the previous 28 days (166). The prior period still contains the 13 Aug peak (16 clicks) and the 18 Aug peak (11 clicks); those are the single largest days in the 90-day series and they inflate the comparison base. The current period's best day is 7 Sep with 9 clicks. This is a sliding-window effect on the base, not a collapse in the current period.
Average position keeps improving: 40.3 in the previous 28 days -> 38.0 now, and the last seven days (13-19 Sep) average 28.3, the best weekly position in the series so far.

Impressions are falling fast in the most recent days (19 Sep: 61; 18 Sep: 83; 17 Sep: 75) against 150-280 through late August. Position improved at the same time, so fewer but better-placed impressions - consistent with Google trimming very low-position long-tail serving.
The latest complete week 13-19 Sep has 19 clicks vs 39 in 6-12 Sep (-51.3%). Weekly volumes at this scale swing on single days; 14 Sep recorded 0 clicks on 164 impressions.

GA4 sessions 776 vs 1,286 (-39.7%). The previous window (29 Jul - 25 Aug) still holds the 18 Aug Direct/Singapore/Chrome spike that GA4 itself flags as an anomaly. That spike alone accounts for the bulk of the gap; Direct is -56.3% while Organic Search is only -26.6%. Treat the headline as a base effect.
GA4 quality metrics improved against that inflated base: engagement rate 38.02% (+4.02%), average engagement time 21s (+20.29%), events per session 4.69 (+5.37%).
GA4 key events 15 vs 44 (-65.91%). Organic Search contributes 8 of the 15 (53.3%) from 23.45% of sessions, so organic remains the highest-intent channel by a wide margin.
Paid Search is the standout riser: 162 sessions vs 90 (+80%), engaged sessions +103.45%. It is now the third-largest channel and 20.9% of all sessions.
/technology is the fastest-growing page: 199 views vs 80 (+148.75%), now the second most-viewed page on the site.
GSC and GA4 do NOT share a window this run (GSC ends 19 Sep, GA4 ends 22 Sep). Do not compare GSC clicks against GA4 organic sessions as if they were the same period.
2026-09-22 is the run day and was still in progress when GA4 was read, so it is a part-day and drags the averages down slightly.
LinkedIn impressions 1,732 (-3.6%) on the 21 Aug - 19 Sep window. Followers reached 3,108 (+1 on the last run). New followers in 30 days 13 (-18.8%).
LinkedIn page searches rose to 328 (+1.9%) for 13-19 Sep, the first increase in that metric across recent runs.
